report.summary: Found a medium-severity token boundary bug in _contains_explicit_path that violates the explicit-path claim; one unhandled exception risk in lexical_seed_scores via _symbol_names; no concurrency/atomicity issues in this read-only module.

risks.finding: _contains_explicit_path accepts underscore as a token boundary, causing false positive matches when a file path is a substring of a snake_case identifier (e.g., path 'task' matches 'background_task_handler').
risks.trigger: Any snake_case identifier in event evidence text that contains a file path as a substring.
risks.violation: Docstring states 'Match a path as a token, not as the suffix of another filename' but underscores are not treated as token characters.

risks.finding: lexical_seed_scores calls _symbol_names which may raise an exception if resolution_context fails, with no error handling.
risks.trigger: Malformed index causing resolution_context to raise.

todos: Add '_' to token_chars in _contains_explicit_path to prevent false token boundaries.
Consider wrapping _symbol_names call in try/except to avoid crashing lexical seed scoring.

handoff.suggestion: In _contains_explicit_path, update token_chars to include underscore: token_chars = set('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_.-'). Also consider adding a parameter to control token boundaries. In lexical_seed_scores, catch exceptions from _symbol_names and log a warning, falling back to empty symbols.
